test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Karun borrowed Rs. 12,000 from Varun and Rs. 15,000 from Tarun, each for two years at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If he paid an interest of Rs. 1,680 to Varun at the end of 2 years, then what is the interest that Karun paid to Tarun at the end of the 2-year period?
solution:
Given:

Principal (From Varun) = 12,000

Rate = r%

Time = 2 years

S.I paid = Rs.1,680

Principal (From Tarun) = 15,000

Formula used:

SI = Prt/100

Calculations:

Case-1

According to the formula

1,680 = [(12,000 × r × 2)/100] 

⇒ 1,68,000 = 24,000r

⇒ r = (168)/(24)

⇒ r = 7

⇒ r = 7%

Now, SI to be paid to Tarun

= (15,000 × 7 × 2)/100

= Rs. 2,100

∴ The Simple interest paid to Tarun is Rs. 2,100.
